answer: Make each seat prove its own Bitcoin hashrate. Every epoch a seat submits mining shares at a set difficulty whose coinbase commits its poa address and the epoch beacon, so work can't be reused or pooled across seats. Holding 1 TH/s takes about 17.5 W, roughly $0.04 a day (figures assumed). Each share is a steady pulse of real energy: a reef of 1,000 clones must burn 1 PH/s, about $42 a day, and no atlas of rented IPs or VMs can fake that.
